question: Does either 2025 HOME provider publish the Huntington Beach Operating Guidelines incorporated as Exhibit A?

routes: Published page sitemap and both attachment sitemaps
Housing-program and housing-partner pages and linked-document metadata
Public WordPress media search for TBRA, Huntington, guidelines
Public application-document inventory, all five returned pages
findings.result: No identifiable Huntington Beach Operating Guidelines counterpart found. Income-guideline attachments, landlord incentive flyers, job descriptions and provider financial statements do not establish the incorporated edition.

routes: Canonical mercyhouse.net site recovered with ordinary browser User-Agent after initial 403
Published sitemap index and its eight children
Public pages search for Huntington, including actual RFP and Orange County page content
Public media search and full returned application-document inventory
findings.result: No identifiable TBRA guideline counterpart found. Huntington Beach RFPs concern Navigation Center security services; named Exhibit A is a Phase I environmental site assessment, not HOME Operating Guidelines. These are not substitutes or new required jurisdiction instruments.

limits: Inventory review identifies public metadata and relevant page links; it does not establish absence from all online archives or unindexed documents. No claim that all document bodies were read.
decision: No register inclusion, edition or status change. Actual 2025 incorporated guideline edition remains a J1 selection question.
external_contact: None; user prohibits emails or requests to people.
